about_the_game:
Welcome to Soul Launder Inc. 😈

You were promised ascension. Instead, you got a corporate nightmare.

Tricked into signing a cursed contract with Soul Launder Inc., a shady reaper-run company, you’re now stuck laundering lost souls for eternity instead of finding peace.

Secretly, you and your coworkers plot to gather energy from daily work to call for divine help and escape.

But teamwork in the afterlife isn’t easy—especially when your job is pure chaos.

Gameplay Overview

Capture, launder souls, and survive 30 days of work together!
Each shift throws you and your team into a new workplace filled with aching hazards.

You’ll need to:

  • Capture and Subdue Souls – Use the reaper special tool's magic to calm and capture rebellious souls before they vanish for good.

  • Launder & Deliver – Process souls through launder machines, extract their evil energy in dazzling colors, and send them through the Next Life Gate before time runs out.

  • Fix & Assist – Repair broken machines, rescue trapped teammates, or toss souls between players to get the job done.

  • Earn & Customize – Complete levels to earn cosmetic loot boxes and show off your signature reaper style.

Every job is timed, frantic, and hilariously messy. Work together, split tasks—or descend into pure chaos.

Key Features (Full Game)

  • 🏚️ Unique Biomes & Crumbling Offices
    Capture souls across cemeteries inspired by cultures around the world. Each location introduces new traps, machines, and hazards to overcome.

  • 💀 Co-op Mayhem
    Shout, coordinate, and panic together in fast-paced rounds where teamwork decides your fate.

  • 🎭 Cosmetics & Rewards
    Earn loot boxes by reaching score tiers to unlock stylish outfits and flashy effects that let you showoff your reaper style.

  • 🎬 Animated Story Cutscenes
    Progress through 7-day shifts to unlock 2D animated cutscenes revealing the dark secrets behind Soul Launder Inc.—and the interns’ secret escape plan.

  • 🕒 Short, Replayable Sessions
    Each shift lasts just a few minutes—perfect for quick play sessions or chaotic party nights.
detailed_description:
Special Announcement

We’re excited to share that Soul Launder Inc. will be showcased at two amazing events this October!

  • 🎮 SXFW Sydney – October 13–14, 2025

  • 🎮 Gamescom Asia (Bangkok) – October 17–19, 2025

You’ll be able to try out our very early beta gameplay at our booth, meet the dev team, and get a sneak peek at the chaos before launch. Come by, play a round (or ten), and see if you can survive the laundry machines of eternity. 👻🌀

See you there, reapers!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 / AMD FX-6300 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 265 (2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: At least 1 controller required for local multiplayer.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580 or better (4–6 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: 4 controllers for full local multiplayer experiences.

short_description: Chaotic couch co-op party game for 2–4 intern reapers trapped in eternal afterlife labor. Capture and launder souls across haunted cemeteries and crumbling offices. Work together to escape your cursed contract—before you’re the one getting laundered!
